strings.system.ashfall_gate.name: Ashfall Gate
strings.system.ashfall_gate.desc: A quiet yellow star with a habit of swallowing signals. Four worlds turn here; only one still answers a landing request.
strings.system.threshold.name: Threshold
strings.system.threshold.desc: An old transfer station above a dead world. The beacon is dark, but the traffic logs still count ships that never arrived.
strings.planet.vela.name: Vela
strings.planet.vela.desc: A mist moon with a brackish coast, glass reefs, and a settlement that repairs what the tide leaves. Mira's last carrier wave came from somewhere below this cloud line.
strings.planet.brine.name: Brine
strings.planet.brine.desc: A storm ocean. The relay maps mark one listening buoy, last serviced nine years ago.
strings.planet.cinder.name: Cinder
strings.planet.cinder.desc: A dry world of ash basins and grounded dust. The settlement uses it as a cemetery and a weather warning.
strings.planet.tallow.name: Tallow
strings.planet.tallow.desc: An ice moon with a crystalline equator. No landing clearance; the surface is mapped as unstable.
strings.planet.threshold_anchor.name: Threshold Anchor
strings.planet.threshold_anchor.desc: A ring station with a broken docking arm and a working market. Nobody answers the customs channel.
strings.settlement.vela.landing.name: Tidebreak
strings.settlement.vela.landing.desc: Twenty-three people, one market, one relay, and a habit of rebuilding after every spring tide. Kasa keeps the stall and the stories.
strings.market.vela.coast.name: Tidebreak Market
strings.market.vela.coast.explanation: Stock is finite. Prices rise when the shelf is thin and fall when it is full. The stall buys only what it can resell.
strings.ship.hull.salt_skiff.name: Salt Skiff
strings.ship.hull.salt_skiff.desc: A Lantern Union light courier with patched ion fins and a stubborn port clamp. Ari has flown it longer than is sensible.
strings.ship.hull.salt_skiff.lore: The skiff was built for short hops between tide stations. Its previous owner left a hand-drawn chart taped under the console.
strings.ship.hull.photon_courier.name: Photon Courier
strings.ship.hull.photon_courier.desc: A fast civilian hull with room for cargo and very little room for doubt.
strings.ship.hull.photon_courier.lore: A courier's ship: narrow, bright, and always one maintenance cycle behind.
strings.ship.hull.deep_keel.name: Deep Keel
strings.ship.hull.deep_keel.desc: A survey hauler built to carry a base on its back. Slow, roomy, and nearly impossible to lose in a storm.
strings.ship.hull.deep_keel.lore: Tide Works still has the original survey contract framed in its offices. The ink has faded faster than the ship.
strings.ship.hull.glass_wren.name: Glass Wren
strings.ship.hull.glass_wren.desc: A tiny scout with a huge jump coil and very little protection. The kind of ship you take when you are certain you can leave.
strings.ship.hull.glass_wren.lore: Built for couriers who preferred silence to cargo. Almost all of them were recalled after the beacon shutdown.
strings.ship.module.scan_array.name: Scan array
strings.ship.module.scan_array.desc: A short-range sensor mast. It reads living signatures before they read you.
strings.ship.module.ion_fins.name: Ion fins
strings.ship.module.ion_fins.desc: Low-thrust attitude fins. They make landing on a wet moon feel almost intentional.
strings.ship.module.cargo_pods.name: Cargo pods
strings.ship.module.cargo_pods.desc: External pods with their own mass and their own opinions about maneuverability.
strings.ship.module.long_jump_coil.name: Long-jump coil
strings.ship.module.long_jump_coil.desc: A heavy coil that stretches a one-system hop into two. It draws power like a hungry thing.
strings.ship.module.heat_sink.name: Heat sink
strings.ship.module.heat_sink.desc: A bus-sized radiator folded into a utility slot. The quietest module on the skiff.
strings.ship.module.landing_clamps.name: Landing clamps
strings.ship.module.landing_clamps.desc: Reinforced clamps for uneven ground. Ari has been meaning to replace the port one for years.
strings.build.power_cell.name: Power cell
strings.build.power_cell.desc: A buried salt-cell stack. Supplies six units of base power without moving parts.
strings.build.smelter.name: Field smelter
strings.build.smelter.desc: A powered kiln that turns one saltglass shard into one alloy plate every twenty seconds. It needs a connection to a power cell.
strings.build.habitat.name: Habitat shell
strings.build.habitat.desc: A sealed living shell with room for two. It makes the base a place someone could stay.
strings.build.signal_mast.name: Signal mast
strings.build.signal_mast.desc: A relay mast that extends field scanning and marks the landing site for passing ships.
strings.mode.scan.name: Scan
strings.mode.scan.desc: A low-power biographical sweep. It observes without touching.
strings.mode.scan.ethics: Observe at a respectful distance. Never crowd a creature's escape route.
strings.mode.sample.name: Sample
strings.mode.sample.desc: A careful field harvest. It takes only what a plant can spare and leaves the root structure intact.
strings.mode.sample.ethics: Take one part, not the whole. Respect recovery time.
strings.mode.dampen.name: Dampen
strings.mode.dampen.desc: A fictional defensive pulse that interrupts aggression without causing pain or injury.
strings.mode.dampen.ethics: Calm only what cannot leave. A calmed animal still needs its territory.
strings.ecology.vela.mist_coast.name: Vela mist coast
strings.ecology.vela.mist_coast.summary: A brackish coast where mineral mist feeds reeds, glass reefs shelter pollinators, and the tide sets the pace. Twelve species are recorded here; the settlement depends on all of them.
strings.ecology.note.saltreed: Saltreed binds the dune and feeds the grazers. Cutting the frayed edge is pruning; cutting the crown is erosion.
strings.ecology.note.glassbell: Glassbells collect salt for the soil and shelter small animals. Their shed shards are the only sustainable harvest.
strings.ecology.note.mistmoss: Mistmoss holds water in the understory. The whole coast dries faster when a colony is scraped away.
strings.ecology.note.lumen_kelp: Lumen kelp is a nursery before it is a resource. The reef singers raise their young in its canopy.
strings.ecology.note.ash_orchid: Ash orchid and echo moth are a pair. A flower picked is a moth route broken.
strings.ecology.note.tide_heather: Tide heather fixes nitrogen for the heath. The dune's stability is mostly underground.
strings.ecology.note.pale_fungus: Pale fungus recycles the cave's dead matter. Its mycelium may predate the settlement.
strings.ecology.note.crystal_thistle: Crystal thistle concentrates minerals. Its shed spines are a deposit; its living crown is a habitat.
strings.ecology.note.veil_fern: Veil fern turns fog into water. The small animals in its crown drink before the settlement does.
strings.ecology.note.silent_bulb: Silent bulb stores light across the ash season. The night drifters navigate by its glow.
strings.ecology.note.drowned_reed: Drowned reed filters the marsh. What it carries into the water, the reef inherits.
strings.ecology.note.star_cactus: Star cactus is a water bank for the dry ridge. The stilt walkers spread its seeds in exchange.
strings.ecology.note.mist_manta: Mist manta filters mineral fog into the food web. Its migration follows the mist, not the settlement.
strings.ecology.note.tide_grazer: Tide grazer keeps the reed beds from overgrowing. It is prey for the salt fox and the ash heron.
strings.ecology.note.shell_crawler: Shell crawler recycles shed shell into new shelter. Its burrows aerate the wet sand.
strings.ecology.note.glasswing: Glasswing pollinates glassbell and thistle in one flight. The crystal flats would close without it.
strings.ecology.note.echo_moth: Echo moth pollinates ash orchid in the dark. It is also food for the heron when the tide is high.
strings.ecology.note.salt_fox: Salt fox scavenges the heath and keeps carrion from collecting. It is cautious because the heron is patient.
strings.ecology.note.reef_singer: Reef singer keeps the kelp nursery healthy by trimming older growth. Its song is a map of the coast.
strings.ecology.note.ash_heron: Ash heron is the coast's apex predator. Its patience is not a threat to careful observers.
strings.ecology.note.mote_swarm: Mote swarm moves spores uphill. The mist forest would starve without the cloud.
strings.ecology.note.hollow_crab: Hollow crab builds shelter mounds from shed spines. Those mounds are nurseries for everything smaller.
strings.ecology.note.night_drifter: Night drifter carries plankton between the shallows and the deep. It is a vertical migration in one body.
strings.ecology.note.stilt_walker: Stilt walker spreads star cactus seeds across the dry ridge. Its route is older than the settlement.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.title: A Signal Through Ash
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.summary: Mira's carrier wave points at Vela. Reach the coast, learn what lives there, and bring the old relay back online without stripping the place bare.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.step.surface: Land on Vela and step onto the mist coast.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.step.witness: Observe two living species without harming them.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.step.salvage: Hold at least two crystal fiber from the coast.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.step.talk_kas: Speak with Kasa at the Tidebreak landing.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.step.relay: Restore the relay console with a calibrated lens.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.journal.surfa: The skiff set down on a wet shelf of glass and reed. The air tastes of salt and cold batteries.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.journal.witne: Two lives recorded. Neither needed to be touched.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.journal.salva: The fiber is warm from the mist. The reed stand can spare it.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.journal.craft: The lens focuses a carrier wave into a needle of amber light.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.journal.talk_: Kasa checks the lens against the light, then against her own reflection. She says Mira's voice was on the relay the night it went dark.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.journal.relay: The relay draws power from the old lines. A green light climbs the mast.
strings.quest.main.prologue.signal.journal.compl: The relay answers with a packet of coordinates. Threshold. The next dark place.
strings.quest.side.kasa_garden.title: A Garden That Belongs to No One
strings.quest.side.kasa_garden.summary: Kasa is trying to grow a garden in soil the tide keeps stealing. She wants to know what lives here before she chooses what to plant.
strings.quest.side.kasa_garden.step.listen: Hear Kasa's plan for the garden.
strings.quest.side.kasa_garden.journal.listen: Kasa has marked a patch of soil above the tide line. The seed packets came from three different dead stations.
strings.quest.side.kasa_garden.journal.count: The garden's future depends on what already lives here. The list is growing.
strings.quest.side.kasa_garden.journal.complete: Kasa takes the list without thanking me. Later, a packet of fiber weave appears on the skiff's step.
strings.journal.intro: The skiff is running on reserve power. Mira's last signal points at the mist moon Vela. Sol has gone quiet in the way that means she is thinking.
strings.journal.landing: The skiff settles into wet glass and reed. Sol keeps the engines warm.
strings.journal.relay.repaired: The relay is awake. Its old mast paints a green line across the mist.
strings.journal.talk.npc.kasa: Kasa talks while she works. She does not ask me to agree with her.
strings.journal.build.power_cell: A power cell hums against the pad. The camp has a heartbeat now.
strings.journal.build.smelter: The smelter takes saltglass and gives back alloy. Its heat pushes the mist away.
strings.journal.build.habitat: Shelter, sealed and lit. Two people could sleep here without holding their breath.
strings.journal.build.signal_mast: The signal mast turns slowly, listening for anything that remembers Mira's frequency.
strings.journal.build.produced: The camp produced something while I was away.
strings.journal.kasa.calibration: Kasa calibrated the lens against the relay's old frequency. She did not ask what Mira's voice sounded like.
